behavior: Generic immutable persistence treats caller batches as untrusted and rebuilds canonical table/column contracts, identities, identity digests, row digests, operation count, SQL plans and batch hash before any database prepare or transport.
Only canonical INSERT statements generated from whitelisted System2 tables/columns can reach D1; caller-provided UPDATE-as-insert SQL is not execution authority.
Every inserted immutable row receives exact post-write readback and canonical equality verification.
Measured statement ledger records select/insert/lineage/readback/write transport activity and hashes.
Decision persistence verifies factor/regime parent existence and matching date/clock/symbol lineage; decision corrections are append-only and require an existing original decision.
Execution/outcome persistence independently canonicalizes SQL/digests and verifies order-to-decision, fill-to-order and outcome-to-decision lineage without changing CORR-012 monotonic-outcome policy.
negativeCoverage: AP-08 caller UPDATE-as-insert becomes SAFE and is rejected before db.batch.
Tampered batch hash, row digest, identity, table, column and SQL plan fail closed before transport.
Concurrent/post-write row divergence fails exact readback verification.
Missing or mismatched decision/factor/regime/order/fill/outcome parents fail closed.
